description: This file contains code to fetch sponsor data from GitHub's GraphQL API, process it, and update a local YAML file used for displaying sponsors. It includes data models, API request functions, and main execution logic for version control automation.

classes.name: SponsorEntity
classes.description: Represents a sponsor's entity, including login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: Tier
classes.description: Represents the sponsorship tier with name and monthly price.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerNode
classes.description: Defines a sponsorship node with the sponsor entity and tier information.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge
classes.description: Defines an edge in the sponsorship connection, including cursor and node.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainer
classes.description: Encapsulates a list of sponsorship edges.

classes.name: SponsorsUser
classes.description: Contains a user's sponsorships as a maintainer.

classes.name: SponsorsResponseData
classes.description: Wraps the data returned from the GraphQL sponsors query.

classes.name: SponsorsResponse
classes.description: The top-level model for the sponsors GraphQL response.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class holding API tokens, repository info, and timeout settings.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Executes a POST request to the GitHub GraphQL API and returns parsed JSON data.

methods.name: list[SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge] get_graphql_sponsor_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sponsorship edges from GitHub GraphQL API, handling pagination.

methods.name: defaultdict[float,dict[str,SponsorEntity]] get_individual_sponsors( settings: Settings, )
methods.description: Aggregates sponsors grouped by their tier's monthly price, returning a nested dict.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Updates the content of a YAML file if the new content differs from the existing one.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates fetching sponsors, updating YAML, and automating Git operations to create a pull request.

ctags.signature: ( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )

ctags.signature: ( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
